column5: Imagine looking up at the sky…
And seeing an asteroid so massive, it swallows the Sun.
Scientists have just confirmed the truth.
Then the asteroid enters the atmosphere.
And there's nowhere left to run.
A blinding flash erupts on the horizon.
An enormous wall of dust tears through the city.
Days later, fires still burn across the landscape.
And millions of survivors search for food.
Deep inside an underground shelter, a radio suddenly crackles to life.
A scientist speaks through the static.
Through the black clouds, a second asteroid appears.
It's even bigger than the first.
